findings.body: The source filter recognizes only ast.Assign. A module defining `COMMANDS: list[dict] = [...]` satisfies the declared format but is silently skipped, so its command never appears or runs. Annotated GROUP_HELP-only modules are likewise ignored. The contract reader also skips annotated declarations at tests/test_contracts.py:539. Support annotated assignments in both discovery paths and cover this case through the CLI.
findings.title: Recognize annotated command declarations

findings.body: Parser construction still consumes centralized TABLE and GROUPS declarations, so Done-when item 2 is not fully delivered. plans/FORGE-SPLIT-1.md:41 assigns the remaining migrations to COMMANDS, and lines 63–64 explicitly permit this transitional arrangement. Complete the table removal and remaining module declarations in COMMANDS; this is deferred advice for this branch.
